主要内容: On July 19, 2018, Mellody Hobson, a member of the Board of Directors of The Estée Lauder Companies Inc., notified the Company that she will serve the remainder of her term, which ends on November 13, 2018, and will not stand for re-election at the Company’s 2018 Annual Meeting of Stockholders on that date. Ms. Hobson has been a member of the Board of Directors since 2005, and the Company is grateful for her valuable contributions.
